summary.name: LobbyDuo (hotellobby)
summary.one_liner: LobbyDuo (tryhotellobby.app) is a paid web tool that turns two uploaded adult face photos into a ~15-second orange, COLORS-style booth duo video with original or AI booth audio.
keywords: make hotel lobby video from photos
use_cases: Making a Hotel Lobby-style booth video from two photos
Creating a short vertical duo clip for social media
Comparing pay-per-video AI tools against subscription editors
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes two adult face photos (Photo 1 on the left, Photo 2 on the right) and generates a ~15-second orange booth duo video in 9:16, 16:9 or 21:9 at 480p or 720p, with original or AI booth-style audio. A free scene preview lets you check framing before paying. Generation uses a site-locked catalog prompt, so users do not write their own prompts. Pricing is per video via one-time credit packs paid through Stripe, with no app, account or subscription required. Source photos are described as not kept as a long-term gallery, and render download links expire.
notable: Two-photo booth duo with a locked orange COLORS-style prompt
One-time packs ($8.88 single, $16.99 3-pack, $29.90 creator) with no subscription or account
Independent of Migos and COLORS; uses original or AI booth audio
caveats: Paid per video; 720p render costs $8.88 for one video, 480p uses fewer credits
Adults 18+ with photo rights only; celebrities, babies and strangers out of scope
Not affiliated with Migos or any label; does not claim rights to the Hotel Lobby song
